# A look at Dopbase's built-in Admin UI

Dopbase includes its Admin UI in the same executable as the server and CLI.

The repository demo shows projects, environments, and the secrets table. You can use the browser interface alongside the CLI to manage your local instance.

[Watch the Dopbase demo](https://github.com/dopbase/dopbase#demo).

Do you prefer managing secrets through the CLI, the browser, or both? Share a workflow or a screenshot with all secret values hidden.
